meta.source: Authored for the Fauxkemon replica; light-theme UI colours, card colours and card geometry are measured from official screenshots and card renders.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind panels: the pale blue-lavender page wash. Hero screens lay `gradient-wall` or a section colour over it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, pills, list rows, the filter panel, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, speech bubbles and round icon buttons; always with `shadow-2` or `shadow-3`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: search fields, the empty-dex slot, the deck-list gutter.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, the card inspector and pack opening; the original also blurs what's behind.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Background outside the board circle on your side of the centre line.

tokens.name: field-opp
tokens.usage: Background outside the board circle on the opponent's side.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Your half of the mat inside the board circle. Text on it uses `ink`; Energy badges and slots sit on it.

tokens.name: board-opp
tokens.usage: The opponent's half of the mat inside the circle.

tokens.name: board-band
tokens.usage: The lighter band along the centre line of the mat.

tokens.name: board-rim
tokens.usage: The board circle's rim (about 1.5% of screen height thick).

tokens.name: slot
tokens.usage: Empty Active and Bench slots: a translucent-white rounded rectangle on the mat (this is the flattened value).

tokens.name: slot-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of an empty slot.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Selection and valid-target glow around cards, slots and the Energy stand: a soft outer blur, never a hard border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `ground`, `surface-sunken`, `board`, `board-opp` and every `type-*-tint`. The original's dark slate.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, the UI slate: pill labels, captions, outline icons. On `surface`, `ground`, `surface-sunken` and tints.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (set codes, timestamps) on `surface` and `ground`. Never on tints.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink`-coloured fills: tooltips, the owned-count tab, the player strips.

tokens.name: hp-ink
tokens.usage: Floating HP numerals on the board (28px bold, so 3:1 applies), with a 2px `board-rim` stroke.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and under dialog titles. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders where one is needed (inputs). 3:1 on `surface` and `ground`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline on every focusable element. 3:1 on all surfaces and the mat.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Open, OK, Battle!, Next) and the active Energy orb's ring. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-strong`.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan-coloured text and icons on `surface` and `ground`: links, quiet buttons, the Opening Results rule.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active filters, drop-target wash, tutorial callout borders.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: EXP and mission progress bars, completed-mission gradients. Decorative: a number sits beside it.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: ON track of switches (Auto, Dex view). The original's `#00c4b4` fails 3:1 on `ground`; this one holds it. The knob is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: hp
tokens.usage: The HP bar on board cards, on a `board-rim` track.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Points coins, Pack Points, rare pulls, New badges. Fill with `on-reward` text.

tokens.name: on-reward
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `reward`.

tokens.name: reward-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-coloured text on `surface` and `ground` (Pack Points, rarity names).

tokens.name: reward-tint
tokens.usage: Background of reward callouts and the rare-pull summary row.

tokens.name: coin-ink
tokens.usage: The italic numeral on an earned point coin (13pt disc). Decorative: the score is in the tracker's label.

tokens.name: point-empty
tokens.usage: Unearned point discs in the player strip.

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: Player name strips (slanted), battle icon buttons, filled tab icons. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Notification dots on tabs and tiles.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, KO banners, low HP. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid deck, completed missions as text. Kept off the red-green axis; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on `success`.

tokens.name: hero-battle
tokens.usage: Battle section banner (diagonal lower edge, white title).

tokens.name: hero-social
tokens.usage: Social Hub section banner.

tokens.name: hero-set
tokens.usage: Default expansion panel tint on the pack screen; each set may override it.

tokens.name: rarity-diamond
tokens.usage: ◊ marks in lists. 3:1 on `surface` and every `type-*-tint`.

tokens.name: rarity-star
tokens.usage: ☆ marks in lists. 3:1 on `surface` and every `type-*-tint`.

tokens.name: rarity-crown
tokens.usage: ♕ marks in lists. 3:1 on `surface` and every `type-*-tint`.

tokens.name: rarity-shiny
tokens.usage: ✵ marks in lists. 3:1 on `surface` and every `type-*-tint`.

tokens.name: card-frame
tokens.usage: Silver card border base (◊, ◊◊ and Trainers).

tokens.name: card-frame-highlight
tokens.usage: Brushed highlight streaks on the silver border.

tokens.name: card-frame-shade
tokens.usage: Brushed shadow streaks on the silver border.

tokens.name: card-frame-rare
tokens.usage: ◊◊◊ border: lavender-steel base under a low-saturation rainbow sheen.

tokens.name: card-frame-ex
tokens.usage: ◊◊◊◊ ex border: dark silver base under a strong rainbow holo.

tokens.name: card-frame-immersive
tokens.usage: ☆☆☆ Immersive border: charcoal, with a white window stroke.

tokens.name: card-frame-shiny
tokens.usage: ✵ and ✵✵ border: cyan-mint holo base.

tokens.name: card-frame-crown
tokens.usage: ♕ Crown border and symbols base: gold, holo cycling toward teal.

tokens.name: card-ink
tokens.usage: Name, HP, attack names, damage and effect text on every card body except Darkness.

tokens.name: card-ink-light
tokens.usage: Text on the Darkness card body and on full-art plates.

tokens.name: card-label
tokens.usage: Small grey labels on cards: stage, weakness, retreat, dex line. Sits on `card-pill` and the dex bar at the original's 4.2:1; keep it at or above 2.1% of card width.

tokens.name: card-pill
tokens.usage: Stage pill and footer capsules, light stop.

tokens.name: card-pill-deep
tokens.usage: Stage pill and footer capsules, deep stop.

tokens.name: card-dex-bar
tokens.usage: The dex line strip under the art on ◊–◊◊◊◊ Pokémon.

tokens.name: card-ability
tokens.usage: Ability pill fill (gradient `#df2b37` → `#7c0411` around it), outline `card-ability-outline`.

tokens.name: card-ability-outline
tokens.usage: Ability pill outline.

tokens.name: card-ability-ink
tokens.usage: Ability name text.

tokens.name: card-ex-gold-1
tokens.usage: ex rule box gradient, top.

tokens.name: card-ex-gold-2
tokens.usage: ex rule box gradient, middle; also the ex logotype fill.

tokens.name: card-ex-gold-3
tokens.usage: ex rule box gradient, bottom.

tokens.name: card-ex-tab
tokens.usage: The black tab on the ex rule box; its text is `card-ex-tab-ink`.

tokens.name: card-ex-tab-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the ex rule-box tab.

tokens.name: card-rule-ink
tokens.usage: Rule text inside the gold ex box.

tokens.name: card-ex-outline
tokens.usage: Outline of the ex logotype.

tokens.name: card-trainer-body
tokens.usage: Trainer card body.

tokens.name: card-trainer-band
tokens.usage: Trainer header band.

tokens.name: card-trainer-word
tokens.usage: The TRAINER word, with a white stroke.

tokens.name: card-item
tokens.usage: Item label; Item rule box runs `card-item-box` → `card-item-box-deep`.

tokens.name: card-item-box
tokens.usage: Item rule box, light stop.

tokens.name: card-item-box-deep
tokens.usage: Item rule box, deep stop.

tokens.name: card-supporter
tokens.usage: Supporter label; Supporter rule box runs `card-supporter-box` → `card-supporter-box-deep`.

tokens.name: card-supporter-box
tokens.usage: Supporter rule box, light stop.

tokens.name: card-supporter-box-deep
tokens.usage: Supporter rule box, deep stop.

tokens.name: card-fullart-ink
tokens.usage: Text fill on full-art cards, stroked with `card-fullart-outline`.

tokens.name: card-fullart-outline
tokens.usage: Text outline on full-art cards.

tokens.name: card-evolves-band
tokens.usage: Evolves-from band over the art at 60% alpha, white text.

tokens.name: card-rarity-diamond
tokens.usage: ◊ symbol stroke printed on the card (the fill is a silver gradient).

tokens.name: card-rarity-star
tokens.usage: ☆ symbol printed on the card.

tokens.name: card-rarity-shiny
tokens.usage: ✵ symbol printed on the card.

tokens.name: card-rarity-crown
tokens.usage: ♕ symbol printed on the card; also the Crown body's symbol colour.

tokens.name: card-crown-body-1
tokens.usage: Crown card body gradient, top.

tokens.name: card-crown-body-2
tokens.usage: Crown card body gradient, bottom.

families.display: Cabin, "Gill Sans", "Gill Sans Nova", Calibri, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: Cabin, "Gill Sans", "Gill Sans Nova", Calibri, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.numeral: Jost, Futura, "Century Gothic", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Full-screen moments (Got it!, Ranked up!, win and loss): white on a diagonal section colour with a soft slate shadow.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Set names on the pack screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles (centred, with `gradient-rainbow` under them), dialog titles at 18px.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: Floating HP numerals on board cards, in `hp-ink` with a 2px `board-rim` stroke.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: Counts in panels (cards owned, 20/20), damage pop-ups (scaled up).

styles.name: numeral-m
styles.usage: Pack Points, stamina timers, owned-count tabs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI and dialog body text (the original's 13pt reads as 15px on the web).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, list-row primary lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pill buttons (13–16px by size), tabs, chips, form labels, the player strip.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tile labels under icon tiles, set codes, counters. Never for anything the player must read to act.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Card name: 6.6% of card width, cap top at 4.6% of card height, starting 18% in from the left edge.

styles.name: card-hp
styles.usage: HP number on cards: 6.9% of card width, right-aligned at 87.2%, with a 3.2% 'HP' label before it.

styles.name: attack-name
styles.usage: Attack names at 4.9% and Ability names at 5.0% of card width, starting at 30.5%.

styles.name: attack-damage
styles.usage: Attack damage: 6.2% of card width, right-aligned at 93.3%.

styles.name: card-text
styles.sample: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
styles.usage: Effect and rule text: 3.8% of card width, line height 1.22, in `card-ink`. Hidden below 220px wide.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Stage pill, Weakness and Retreat labels, dex line: 2.1–2.2% of card width in `card-label`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps between Energy pips and inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside list rows and chips; gap between hand cards when not fanned.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default panel padding and the phone screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between Bench slots on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a screen; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the two Active Spots; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separation between major screen regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of hero moments (pack picker, win screen).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Energy cost pips inside attack rows, focus-ring corners on pips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows, board slots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the booster pack wrapper.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Card corners as a share of card width (≈14px on a 300px card), so corners scale with the card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, the tab bar, point pips, Energy badges.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting panels and list rows on `ground`.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the card being dragged, the inspected card.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card at rest: in hand, on the board, in the binder.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale-down on tap).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, selection, chip toggles, tab changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Cards moving between zones, sheets opening.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Card flips, the Energy attach arc, screen transitions.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: A rare-card reveal beat; the pack cut.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or responding to the player: the default.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving from one place on screen to another (card to Bench).

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Small overshoot for badges, points and damage numbers appearing. Never on large surfaces.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only: a KO'd card leaving, a dismissed toast.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for any control.

tokens.name: size-card-hand
tokens.usage: Card width in the hand fan and on your Bench: 22.6% of a 390px phone.

tokens.name: size-card-board
tokens.usage: Your Active card width on phone (32% of 390px). The opponent's Active is 0.95× and foreshortened; their Bench cards 0.82×.

tokens.name: size-card-inspect
tokens.usage: Card width in the inspector on phone.

tokens.name: card-aspect
tokens.usage: Every card face and slot. Matches a standard trading card.

tokens.name: size-energy-badge
tokens.usage: Attached-Energy badge diameter on board cards (about 7% of phone width); 20px inside attack rows.

tokens.name: size-energy-stand
tokens.usage: The Energy Zone stand (15% of phone width); its next-type badge is 20px.

tokens.name: size-icon-button
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (back, close) on menu screens; 35px for the battle menu button.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Visual height of the bottom tab bar, before the home-indicator padding.

tokens.name: gradient-rainbow
tokens.usage: The 2px rule under screen titles (My Cards, Wonder Pick) and the thin Opening Results rule.

tokens.name: gradient-wall
tokens.usage: The upper 'wall' of the pack screen; it meets a `surface` 'floor' on a slightly diagonal line at about 42% of screen height.

tokens.name: gradient-sky
tokens.usage: Wonder Pick, the pack tear screen and Opening Results backgrounds.

tokens.name: gradient-end-turn
tokens.usage: The 2px hairline border of the End Turn pill.

tokens.name: gradient-attack
tokens.usage: The diagonal attack-name banner (an estimate; the original is red to orange).

tokens.name: gradient-complete
tokens.usage: Completed-mission rows.

tokens.name: z-board
tokens.usage: Board and slots.

tokens.name: z-hand
tokens.usage: The hand fan.

tokens.name: z-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: A card or Energy being dragged.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and the card inspector.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and pack opening.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Turn and KO banners.
